title: dataperformance
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): organizationid.

anyoptimizationapplied.description: An internal state which indicates whether at least one optimization is applied.

anyoptimizationavailable.description: An internal state which indicates whether at least one optimization is available for this record.

count.description: Number of times a queries were executed (Aggregated)

dataperformanceid.description: Unique identifier of the performance suggestion.

estimatedoptimizationimpact.description: The expected average cost benefit of an optimization.

executionperiod.description: The execution period for which the performance metrics are calculated.

lastactionresult.description: An internal state which shows the result of the last action that was taken on this record.

lastoptimizationdate.description: Last time an optimization was applied.

operation.description: Data operation that triggered the query (Retrieve Multiple, etc.)

optimizationstatus.description: Current optimization status of the record, showed to the customer.

realizedoptimizationimpact.description: Actual performance change after taking an optimization action on the record.

solution.description: Name of the solution that owns the component

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated.
